title: Food App UI/UX Poster with Labelled Components
whatItIs: A cream A4-style poster titled 'FOOD APP' with labelled components: search bar, category pills, featured restaurant card, food item cards, product detail card, shopping cart, delivery tracking and bottom navigation, decorated with illustrated food, fries and a scooter rider.
whatItMeans: Labels on the left name every component, and playful food illustrations keep the technical sheet friendly.

Scattered sparkles and fries as decoration
